resources.string: Send a friend the same 10 questions and compare, or climb today\'s leaderboard.

Challenges and the leaderboard need an internet connection. The app signs you in anonymously and sends a nickname it picks for you, your quiz scores and times, and nothing else. Nothing is sent until you turn it on.

World Flags will create an anonymous account for you on Firebase (a Google service) and send: a nickname picked from a list (you can draw another), the scores, right answers and times of the challenges and daily challenges you play, and the codes of the challenges you share. No name, email address, contacts or location. You can turn it off, or delete this data, in Settings at any time.
Online play is not available in this build of the app.
No internet connection. Try again when you are online.
Something went wrong online. Try again in a moment.
Names are picked from a list, so nobody can write anything hurtful.
You play 10 questions first, then share the code: your friends get the same questions and the same answers to pick from.
A code has 6 letters and digits, like %1$s.
No challenge has that code. Check it with your friend; challenges expire after %1$d days.

No challenges yet. Start one and share its code, or enter a code a friend sent you.

Finish today\'s challenge to join the leaderboard
Friend challenges and the daily leaderboard. Sends a nickname and your scores to Firebase; nothing else leaves the device.
Your nickname, the challenges you made and every score you posted are deleted from the server, and online play is turned off. Your progress on this phone stays as it is.

Online play is optional and off until you turn it on. It then signs you in anonymously with Firebase (a Google service) and sends a nickname picked from a list and the scores and times of the challenges you play. Settings > Online play turns it off and deletes that data.
